# EEL RIVER BASIN

# 11-4722. Outlet Creek near Longvale, Calif.

Location.--Lat 39°37'05" long 123°21'20" in NEt sec.1 T.20 N. R.14 W. on right bank 0.2 mile downstream from Bloody Run Creek, 0.9 mile upstream from mouth, and 8.2 miles downstream from Longvale.

Drainage area.--161 sq mi.

Records available.--October 1956 to September 1965.

Gage.--Digital water-stage recorder. Datum of gage is 1,018.14 ft above mean sea level, datum of 1929, supplementary adjustment of 1960. Prior to May 25, 1964, graphic water-stage recorder at same site and datum.

Average discharge --9 years, 436 cfs (315,700 acre-ft per year).

Extremes Maximums and minimums (discharge in cubic feet per second, gage height in feet).

Annual maximum discharge (*) and peak discharges above base (7,000 cfs, revised), water years 1961-65
